caption_L1: Here a area plot is called Infant mortality rate (under one year old) in Japan from 1920 to 2020. The y-axis plots Deaths per 1,000 live births using linear scale with a minimum of 0 and a maximum of 150 while the x-axis shows Year along linear scale of range 1920 to 2000.
caption_L2L3: Infant mortality rate in Japan for under one year olds was much higher in the 1920's at over 150 deaths per thousand live births. The number of Deaths declined sharply through the 1930s, 40s, 50s, 60s and 70's. From approximately 1980, the rate of deaths virtually plateaued out to a very low infant mortality rate per 1000 live births in Japan, until 2020.
